source_contract: Delegate actual run_in_executor, retain its actual returned Future, and force only takes_turns branch.
Canonical worker checkpoint holds after literal real-child readiness and profile/process validation.
Cancel actual caller while checkpoint is held; capture canonical CancelledError in the same coroutine before Task reconstruction.

Positive verifies healthy cleanup exactly once, original browser result and empty loop report snapshot.

result/exception retrieval, callback observation and executor wrapping; runtime uses C-backed Future

limitations: No tests, native processes, Cargo, lint or formatter executed by reviewer.

Real harmless child and controlled post-cleanup TreeFailure do not establish installed-browser, actual OS fault or Android coverage.
